att.hint: Preview only: files are not uploaded.
att.label: Attachments
att.paste: Tip: press Win+Shift+S, then Ctrl+V to paste a screenshot.

accept.d: You’re taking on “{t}”. It moves to {s}.
accept.multi: This task has {n} assignees and each accepts their own part. {x} of {n} have accepted so far.

approve.d: “{t}” will move to {s} and the assignees will be notified.

cancel.d: The task moves to Cancelled and everyone involved gets the reason. Pending extension requests are declined automatically.
cancel.label: Why cancel
cancel.ph: E.g. the request was handled in another task

cmDel.d: It’s removed for everyone and can’t be recovered.
cmDel.dOther: {a}’s comment is removed for everyone and can’t be recovered.

decline.back: {a} handed this part to you. If you decline, it goes back to {a}, who gets a “Task returned” notification.
decline.ph: E.g. busy with another urgent task, please assign someone else

ext.blockPending: There are already 2 pending requests, the maximum. Wait for a decision or withdraw one first.
ext.blockT: You can’t ask for more time yet
ext.blockTotal: All 5 extension requests for this task have been used. Talk to a Vice Manager in the comments.
ext.dateErr: Pick a date after {d}: later than the current due date, today and any pending request.
ext.quota: {n} of 5 extension requests and {p} of 2 pending slots left. A Vice Manager or Admin will decide.

extNo.d: Only the requester is notified, with your reply.

extOk.d: The new due date is {d}. All assignees are notified.

dlg.forceNote: Mandatory task: it can’t be declined or handed over.

next.approval: Once sent, the task moves to In review for a Vice Manager or Admin to check.
next.direct: This task was assigned directly, so there’s no review: once sent, it moves to Done.
next.wait: {n} other assignee(s) haven’t reported yet. The task moves on only when everyone has reported.

ra.d: Everyone assigned declined or handed it over. Pick one or more people; the task goes back to Awaiting pickup and they get a “Reassigned” notification.

reject.d: The task moves to Cancelled and the creator is notified. A rejected plan can’t be restored.
reject.ph: Optional. E.g. needs a quote before work starts

report.label: Report
report.ph: What you did, the result, anything to watch out for…

restore.d: The task goes back to its status before it was cancelled: {s}.
restore.ppl: Every assignee starts over (Not accepted yet) and has to accept again.

review.d: Confirm “{t}” meets the requirements. It moves to {s}.

rework.d: Pick who needs to redo their part and give each a reason. The task goes back to In progress; everyone else keeps their report.

tpl.hint: General templates plus those for “{ty}”. Picking one replaces what you typed.
tpl.none: No templates yet. Admins or Vice Managers add them in Settings → Completion templates.

tr.d: The person you pick takes over your part and needs to accept it. If they decline, it comes back to you.
tr.hint: People already on this task (including anyone who declined or handed it over) aren’t listed, so it can’t loop back.
tr.loop: {a} just handed this to you, so it can’t go back to them.

wd.d: Your request to move the due date to {d} will be withdrawn. It still counts toward the limit.

app.name: TechOps

phaseB.d: Not in V1 yet, planned for Phase B

app.soon: This page is still being designed and will come in a later preview.

toast.allFailed: Declined {id}. Everyone assigned has declined and the creator was told.
toast.declined: Declined {id}; the assigner has been told.
toast.partial: Your report is in. The task moves to review once every assignee has reported.
toast.partialDirect: Your report is in. The task completes once every assignee has reported.
toast.reassigned: Reassigned {id} to {n} people. It’s now Awaiting pickup.
toast.returned: Declined {id}. The part went back to {a}.
toast.rework: Sent back to {n} assignee(s). {id} is in progress again.

mine.d: Tasks you need to accept, approve or review show up here.

403.d: This page is for Vice Managers and Admins. If you need it for your work, ask an Admin to grant access under People.
403.dShort: Your account doesn’t have access to this page yet. If you need it for your work, ask an Admin to grant access under People.
403.t: You don’t have access to this page

404.d: The link may be old or mistyped. If you opened it from an email, the task may have been deleted.

500.d: Your last action wasn’t saved. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps failing, send the error code below to IT.
500.dShort: This page didn’t load. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps failing, send the error code below to IT.
500.t: Something went wrong on our side

offline.d: Check your Wi-Fi or network cable. This page reloads when you’re back online.

er.still: Still not working. Try again in a few minutes.

toast.403: You don’t have permission to do that.
toast.429: You’re going a bit fast. Wait {n} seconds and try again.
toast.500: The server hit a problem and your change wasn’t saved. Try again in a few minutes.
toast.net: Can’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

err.auth: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
err.commentNotFound: We couldn’t find that comment. It may have been deleted.
err.emailFailed: The email couldn’t be sent. Check the SMTP settings and try again.
err.extDate: That date doesn’t work: it must be after the current due date, today and any pending request.
err.extMax: All 5 extension requests for this task have been used.
err.extNotFound: We couldn’t find that extension request. It may already have been handled.
err.extPending: There are already 2 pending requests, the maximum. Wait for a decision or withdraw one first.
err.failed: That didn’t go through. Try again in a few minutes.
err.fileType: {ext} files aren’t allowed. Only PDF files are accepted.
err.flowSwitch: The workflow can’t be changed at this stage.
err.forbidden: You don’t have permission to do that.
err.forceMode: Mandatory task: it can’t be declined or handed over.
err.forceModeApproval: Mandatory mode only works with the approval workflow.
err.generic: Something went wrong and the action wasn’t completed.
err.genericCode: Something went wrong and the action wasn’t completed (code {code}).
err.helpdeskConfig: The Helpdesk connection isn’t set up yet.
err.inUse: This item is in use, so it can’t be deleted yet.
err.invalid: Some fields aren’t valid. Check what you entered.
err.network: Can’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
err.notAssignee: You’re no longer an assignee on this task, or it’s already been handled.
err.notFound: We couldn’t find that. It may have been deleted.
err.origin: The request was blocked because it didn’t come from TechOps. Reload the page and try again.
err.otp: The OTP code is wrong or has expired.
err.priorityInUse: This priority is used by some tasks, so it can’t be deleted yet.
err.rateLimit: You’re going a bit fast. Wait a moment and try again.
err.samePassword: The new password must be different from the current one.
err.sameUser: You can’t hand a task over to yourself.
err.server: The server hit a problem and your change wasn’t saved. Try again in a few minutes.
err.smtp: Can’t connect to the mail server. Check the SMTP settings.
err.smtpDecrypt: The saved SMTP settings can’t be read (the encryption key changed). Enter the SMTP settings again and save.
err.smtpKey: The server has no SMTP encryption key configured. Contact your system admin.
err.statusChanged: This task’s status has changed. Reload the page and try again.
err.taskNotFound: We couldn’t find that task. It may have been deleted.
err.taskTypeInUse: This task type is used by some tasks, so it can’t be deleted yet.
err.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.
err.userDuplicate: That username or email is already taken.
err.userHasTasks: This user still has tasks, so they can’t be deleted yet.
err.weakPassword: The password doesn’t meet the password policy.

idle.d: You’ve been inactive for almost {m} minutes. Signing out in

expired.d: You were signed out because you were inactive.

idle.t: Your session is about to end

n.allFailed: Everyone assigned declined “{t}”. You can cancel it or ask an Admin to reassign it.

notif.adminNoMail: Admins don’t get task emails, only in-app notifications.
notif.title: Notifications

af.admin: Use Reassign to pick someone else. The task goes back to Awaiting pickup.
af.boss: An Admin can reassign it. {a} (creator) has been told.
af.creator: You created this task, so you can cancel it. Only Admins have the Reassign button.
af.holder: Nobody is on it. Waiting to be reassigned or cancelled
af.t: Everyone assigned declined or handed it over

ext.auto: Declined automatically because the task has ended.
ext.rules: Up to 2 pending at a time, 5 in total per task.

h.returned: {a} declined; the part went back to {b}

na.d: Staff only see tasks they created or are assigned to (unless it’s awaiting approval). Ask a Vice Manager or Admin to add you if you need it.
na.t: You don’t have access to this task

ne.d: Lost the connection to the server. Check your network and try again.

nf.d: The code may be mistyped, or the task was removed from the system.

turn.reassign: Everyone declined. Your turn to reassign
turn.supplement: You can add to your report

wait.DRAFT: This task is still a draft.
wait.PENDING_APPROVAL: Waiting for a Vice Manager or Admin to approve the plan.
wait.PENDING_REVIEW: Waiting for a Vice Manager or Admin to sign off.
wait.reported: You’ve reported. Waiting on the others.

nf.d: It may have been removed, or you don’t have access to it.
